# Claude Code Playbooks

> A free, open-source collection of 551+ ready-to-use AI workflows for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Windsurf, Cursor, and other AI coding agents. Each playbook is a copy-paste CLAUDE.md template.

Browse, search, and copy playbooks that turn AI coding agents into specialized tools for any task — from file organization to financial analysis to scientific research.

## Docs

- [Browse All Playbooks](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks): Search and filter the full playbook catalog
- [Latest Playbooks](https://www.claudecodehq.com/latest): Most recently added playbooks
- [Blog](https://www.claudecodehq.com/blog): Guides, tutorials, and Claude Code tips
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Danielopol/Claude-Code-Playbooks): Source code and contributions

## File Organization

- [7-Minute Digital Declutter](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/digital-declutter): Complete digital cleanup of photos, documents, and downloads in 7 minutes with intelligent recommendations.
- [Auto-Organize Downloads Folder](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/auto-organize-downloads): Automatically sort and organize files in your Downloads folder by type, date, or custom rules.
- [Bulk Image Extractor](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/bulk-image-extractor): Extract all images from Google Docs, PDFs, websites, and other documents in high resolution.
- [Business Analytics Reporter](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/business-analytics-reporter): Analyze sales and revenue data from CSV files to identify weak areas, generate statistical insights, and provide strategic improvement recommendations.
- [Claude Code Session History Recovery](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/session-history-recovery): Lost code from a previous Claude Code session? Search and recover code snippets, file changes, and solutions from your Claude Code chat history. Never lose work again.
- [CSV & Excel Data Analyst](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/csv-data-analyst): Ask questions about your spreadsheets in plain English. Get insights, summaries, and visualizations without knowing formulas or pivot tables.
- [CSV Data Visualizer](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/csv-data-visualizer): Create professional data visualizations, statistical reports, and interactive dashboards from CSV files for analysis and presentations.
- [Data Analyst Toolkit — CSV Analysis & Dashboard Generator](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/data-analyst-skill): Analyze CSV and Excel data with automatic missing value detection, intelligent imputation, and interactive Plotly dashboards. Generate exploratory data analysis reports in minutes with Claude Code.
- [Disk Space Analyzer](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/disk-space-analyzer): Find exactly what's eating your disk space with categorized breakdown and prioritized cleanup recommendations.
- [Duplicate File Detector](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/duplicate-file-detector): Find exact duplicates, near-duplicates, and version variants across your files with smart recommendations - never auto-deletes.
- [Intelligent File Organizer](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/intelligent-file-organizer): Analyze folders, detect duplicates, suggest logical arrangements, and automate cleanup with context-aware file organization.
- [Mac Performance Diagnostics](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/mac-performance-diagnostics): Run diagnostic commands, analyze results in plain English, and get resolution steps for Mac performance issues.
- [Natural Language Home Automation](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/home-automation-assistant): Translate natural language into home automation configs for Home Assistant, HomeKit, and SmartThings.
- [Old File Cleanup Assistant](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/old-file-cleanup): Identify safely deletable old files with intelligent recommendations based on age, type, and usage patterns.
- [Photo Organizer by Event](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/photo-organizer-event): Organize photos by reading EXIF metadata and analyzing content to create Year > Month > Event folder structures automatically.
- [Project Inventory & Documentation](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/project-inventory): Analyze project folders to understand what each does, identify tech stacks, and create documented inventories.
- [Screenshot Organizer](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/screenshot-organizer): Organize thousands of screenshots by analyzing their visual content. Claude reads text in images to create meaningful names and categories.
- [Smart Downloads Organizer](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/smart-downloads-organizer): Intelligently organize your Downloads folder by analyzing file content, not just extensions. Claude reads files to categorize them meaningfully.

## Task Management

- [Inbox Zero Manager](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/inbox-zero-manager): Process overwhelming email backlogs with bulk categorization, response drafting, and smart prioritization - all with your approval.
- [Meeting Conflict Analyzer](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/meeting-conflict-analyzer): Process call transcripts to identify instances of conflict avoidance, unspoken concerns, and communication patterns.
- [Meeting Notes to Action Items](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/meeting-notes-to-actions): Transform meeting transcripts into structured notes with action items, decisions, and follow-ups automatically extracted.
- [Smart Todo Manager](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/smart-todo-manager): Add tasks to markdown-based todo lists with intelligent routing, duplicate detection, and automatic priority assignment.
- [Task & Project List Organizer](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/recipe-task-organizer): Transform scattered tasks from every source into a prioritized, organized system with realistic weekly plans.
- [Todo List Reviewer](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/todo-list-reviewer): Aggregate tasks across multiple todo files, detect duplicates, and generate prioritized summary views with an interactive action menu.

- [AI Knowledge Library with Historical Personas](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/ai-editorial-library): Build a personal knowledge library where AI personas (Turing, Curie, and more) write editorials from your notes. A Zettelkasten-powered learning system using Claude Code.
- [AI-Powered Second Brain](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/ai-second-brain): Transform your notes into a queryable knowledge base that synthesizes information and surfaces connections.
- [Background Research Processor](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/background-research): Conduct research in the background while you focus on other work, with compiled findings and summaries.
- [Chat History Mind Mapper — Visualize AI Conversations](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/chat-history-mind-mapper): Export Claude or ChatGPT chat history, chunk it into summaries, and generate a visual mind map of topics and insights. Perfect for importing into NotebookLM or Obsidian.
- [Knowledge Base & FAQ Generation](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/recipe-knowledge-base-faq): Build structured knowledge bases and FAQ libraries from support tickets, documentation, and subject matter expertise.
- [Obsidian Knowledge System](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/obsidian-knowledge-system): Manage your Obsidian vault — auto-generate Maps of Content, build smart tagging taxonomies, discover hidden connections, audit vault health, and consolidate scattered notes.
- [Personal Context Library](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/personal-context-library): Build a persistent knowledge base of context docs that Claude can access across all conversations - your business, career, goals, and more.
- [Personal Knowledge Base — Build a Searchable Second Brain](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/personal-knowledge-base): Build a searchable second brain that captures insights with topic clusters and connections between ideas. Never lose a brilliant idea again — Claude Code finds and synthesizes your notes on demand.
- [Quick Reference Guide Creator](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/recipe-reference-guide-creator): Turn complex processes and tribal knowledge into scannable, one-page quick reference guides and cheat sheets.
- [Reading Analysis System](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/reading-analysis-system): Turn passive reading into active learning — capture key arguments, connect books to each other, and identify what to read next to fill gaps.
- [Tips & Knowledge Curator](https://www.claudecodehq.com/playbooks/tips-knowledge-curator): Process emails containing tips and insights, assess quality with novelty and credibility ratings, and maintain a curated knowledge log.
